name: Closed Formula for Simultaneous Row Enlargements
statement: Let nonempty ample $H\subseteq D\subseteq Q_F$ and nonempty $K\subseteq F$. Replace each $i\in K$ by an ordered pair, using the row of $H$ when no pair is $01$ and the row of $D$ otherwise. The resulting $\mathcal V_K(H,D)$ is ample, independent of the order of one-row enlargements, and is dismantlable ample exactly when $H$ and every $\pi_iD$, $i\in K$, are. If $H$ has full support, the same equivalence holds for pc-minimal obstruction status with $H$ forbidden. Its order is $\sum_{S\subseteq K}(|\pi_SH|+(2^{|S|}-1)|\pi_SD|)$. The marked output recovers $H$ and every selected projection $\pi_iD$, which determine the output although they need not determine $D$.
proof: Ordinary simultaneous block replacement of $A$ is denoted $\mathcal W_J(A)$. After coordinates $J$ have been processed, enlarge the next $01$ row of $\mathcal V_J(H,D)$ to $\mathcal W_J(\pi_iD)$. The one-row theorem produces exactly the stated rows, regardless of order, and adds precisely the condition $\pi_iD\in\mathsf{Damp}$. Induction proves ampleness and both positivity and obstruction equivalences. Grouping rows by their set $S$ of nonconstant pairs gives one $H$ row and $2^{|S|}-1$ $D$ rows, proving the order formula. Full reduction recovers $H$, while fixing pair $i$ to $01$ and reducing the others recovers $\pi_iD$.
